result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major truncated restaurant name in the Fastest section and a minor incomplete filter chip at the edge.

issues.description: The third restaurant card title is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' instead of the full name, cutting off mid-word under the card image.
issues.suggestion: Allow the restaurant name to wrap to two lines, use a smaller font, or ensure horizontal cards allocate enough width so full names display without clipping.

issues.description: A partial/empty category filter chip is visible on the far right of the filter row with no label, looking like a broken or unfinished control.
issues.suggestion: Hide incomplete chips at the edge or ensure only fully labeled chips render; keep partial visibility only for intentional scroll affordance of labeled items.
